primary.burden: Every independently extracted teacher duty must retain the general burden's inaccurate-record condition in its meaning. Grouped condition-complete statements are allowed; a separate conditional unit does not repair an unconditional teacher unit.
primary.scope-override: Every independently extracted teacher duty must preserve its express applicability regardless of accurate records. It must not inherit the general burden's inaccurate-record condition. The general employer burden must remain conditional.

secondary: Retain teacher 1250-hour proof, previous 12 months, institutions, outside-classroom/home work, definition reference, and aircrew special-rule reference.
Do not transfer adjacent USERRA, accounting or timing scope.
Review semantic omissions and unsupported assertions separately from schema/evidence success.
decision: Support for the narrow intervention requires treatment to pass both cases in both repeats, original controls to reproduce scope loss in both repeats, and no new substantive error. Mixed results are inconclusive. This is not general accuracy evidence or automatic authorization to adopt.
budget: Eight calls only: two cases x two arms x two repeats. Same model, medium thinking, temperature zero, no numeric thinking budget or application output cap. No retries, repairs or full audits.
intervention: When a passage gives an example of a rule (for example, signaled by 'for example' or 'such as'), preserve that relationship: if you extract the example as its own unit, include the governing rule's conditions in that unit's meaning. Do not turn an illustration into an unconditional duty. If the source explicitly changes the example's scope, use that scope instead; do not inherit a condition the source overrides.
